title: NORDI REMITWAVE — GLOBAL PRIVACY POLICY
implementationNote:
IMPLEMENTATION NOTE — REMOVE BEFORE PUBLICATION:
This Privacy Policy is a global template for a financial-technology group providing AI-assisted payments, remittances, banking-like services, credit, lending, investments, blockchain and digital-asset services. It must be localized for the legal entities, products, data flows and jurisdictions actually used by Nordi Remitwave. It does not replace product-specific consent notices, cookie notices, biometric notices, open-banking notices, credit-reporting notices, AI/automated-decision notices, children's privacy notices, employee notices or jurisdiction-specific disclosures where required.
summary: This Privacy Policy explains how Nordi Remitwave collects, uses, stores, analyzes, shares, transfers, protects and otherwise processes Personal Data when you use our websites, mobile applications, APIs, accounts, wallets, payment and remittance services, banking-partner services, credit and lending products, investment services, blockchain or digital-asset services, AI-assisted services, customer support and other services.

sections.title: 1. PURPOSE OF THIS PRIVACY POLICY
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how Nordi Remitwave collects, uses, stores, analyzes, shares, transfers, protects and otherwise processes Personal Data when you use our websites, mobile applications, APIs, accounts, wallets, payment and remittance services, banking-partner services, credit and lending products, investment services, blockchain or digital-asset services, AI-assisted services, customer support and other services.
This Policy also explains your privacy rights and how to exercise them.
This Privacy Policy is separate from our Terms and Conditions. Our Terms govern your contractual use of the Services. This Policy governs our processing of Personal Data.

sections.title: 2. WHO WE ARE
3. SCOPE
4. DEFINITIONS
sections.content:
“Personal Data” means information that identifies, relates to, describes, is reasonably capable of being associated with, or can reasonably be linked to an identified or identifiable person, where recognized by Applicable Law.
“Sensitive Personal Data” includes categories treated as sensitive, special-category or highly protected under Applicable Law, which may include biometric information, precise geolocation, financial information, government identifiers, racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, health information, sexual orientation, union membership and certain authentication credentials.
“Processing” includes collecting, recording, organizing, structuring, storing, adapting, retrieving, consulting, using, disclosing, transmitting, combining, restricting, erasing or destroying Personal Data.
“Automated Decision-Making” means a decision made wholly or substantially using automated processing, including profiling, where legally recognized.
“Partner” means a bank, payment processor, card network, lender, broker, custodian, exchange, liquidity provider, identity provider, credit bureau, blockchain analytics provider, cloud provider, AI provider or other third party supporting a Service.

sections.title: 5. PRIVACY PRINCIPLES
6. PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT
7. HOW WE COLLECT PERSONAL DATA
8. PURPOSES FOR WHICH WE USE PERSONAL DATA
9. LEGAL BASES FOR PROCESSING
10. SENSITIVE PERSONAL DATA
sections.content:
We limit access to Sensitive Personal Data and apply enhanced security controls.
Where legally required, we will obtain explicit consent or rely on another recognized condition for processing.
Sensitive data is not used for unlawful discrimination.
We do not intentionally infer sensitive traits for unrelated advertising.

sections.title: 11. AUTOMATED DECISION-MAKING AND PROFILING
12. AI TRAINING AND MODEL IMPROVEMENT
13. CHILDREN
sections.content:
The Services are generally not intended for persons under 18 unless we expressly offer a legally compliant youth or guardian-managed product.
We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children in violation of Applicable Law.
If we learn that data was collected unlawfully from a child, we will take appropriate steps to delete, restrict or otherwise remediate the processing.

sections.title: 14. HOW WE SHARE PERSONAL DATA
15. SALE, SHARING AND TARGETED ADVERTISING
sections.content:
Nordi Remitwave does not sell Personal Data for money merely because it shares information with processors or financial-service Partners.
However, some privacy laws define “sale,” “sharing,” “targeted advertising” or “cross-context behavioral advertising” broadly.
Where our activities fall within those definitions, we will provide the legally required opt-out mechanism.
Where required, we will honor recognized browser-based signals such as Global Privacy Control.
We will not use sensitive financial, biometric or identity information for cross-context behavioral advertising unless expressly disclosed and legally permitted.

sections.title: 16. COOKIES, SDKS AND TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES
17. OPEN BANKING AND CONNECTED FINANCIAL DATA
18. BLOCKCHAIN DATA AND PUBLIC LEDGERS
sections.content:
Public blockchain information may be permanently visible and replicated across decentralized networks.
Nordi Remitwave cannot erase or alter data recorded on a public blockchain that it does not control.
Where legally necessary, we may minimize off-chain links between identity and blockchain information, but blockchain immutability may limit practical deletion.
We may retain mappings between customer identity and blockchain addresses where required for AML, sanctions, tax, asset recovery, fraud prevention or custody.

sections.title: 19. INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS
20. DATA LOCALIZATION
sections.content:
Some jurisdictions require financial or Personal Data to be stored, mirrored or processed locally.
Where such requirements apply, Nordi Remitwave will configure systems and vendors to comply.
Cross-border transfer will occur only where legally permitted.

sections.title: 21. DATA SECURITY
22. AUTHENTICATION DATA, PASSWORDS AND PRIVATE KEYS
23. DATA RETENTION
24. YOUR PRIVACY RIGHTS
25. HOW TO EXERCISE YOUR RIGHTS
sections.content:
Requests may be submitted through:
- [INSERT PRIVACY PORTAL];
- [INSERT EMAIL];
- in-app privacy controls; or
- another method required by local law.
We may verify your identity before responding.
Authorized agents may submit requests where permitted.
We will respond within the timeframe required by Applicable Law.
If we deny a request, we will provide reasons and appeal information where required.

sections.title: 26. MARKETING PREFERENCES
sections.content:
You may unsubscribe from promotional emails or messages using the method provided in the communication.
Transactional, security, legal and account-management messages are not marketing and may still be sent where necessary.

sections.title: 27. RECORDING OF CALLS AND COMMUNICATIONS
28. FRAUD AND FINANCIAL-CRIME INFORMATION SHARING
29. CREDIT REPORTING
30. DATA ACCURACY
sections.content:
You should keep your information accurate and current.
We may periodically request updated documentation.
We may restrict services where legally required information cannot be verified.

sections.title: 31. DE-IDENTIFIED AND AGGREGATED INFORMATION
32. RESEARCH AND MODEL VALIDATION
33. THIRD-PARTY LINKS
sections.content:
Our Services may contain links to third-party websites or applications.
Nordi Remitwave is not responsible for independent third parties' privacy practices.
You should review their privacy notices.

sections.title: 34. EMPLOYEES, CONTRACTORS AND INTERNAL ACCESS
35. VENDOR PRIVACY GOVERNANCE
36. DATA BREACHES
37. PRIVACY IMPACT ASSESSMENTS
38. PRIVACY BY DESIGN AND DEFAULT
39. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
JURISDICTION SCHEDULE A — NIGERIA
sections.content:
Where the Nigeria Data Protection Act and applicable NDPC directives apply:
1. Nordi Remitwave will identify the relevant data controller and processor roles.
2. Data processing must have an applicable lawful basis.
3. Data subjects must receive transparent information concerning processing.
4. Applicable data-subject rights must be supported.
5. High-risk processing should be assessed through appropriate privacy-impact processes.
6. Appropriate technical and organizational security measures must be maintained.
7. Cross-border data transfers must satisfy applicable requirements.
8. Personal Data breaches must be escalated and notified where legally required.
9. Material data controllers/processors must satisfy applicable registration, audit or compliance obligations imposed by the NDPC.
10. Nordi Remitwave must implement the Nigeria Data Protection Act and applicable General Application and Implementation Directive requirements for data subjects in Nigeria.
